questions.stemHtml: A 22-Year-old primigravida presents with pain abdomen, contractions and show. She has not had any ANC before. She has no comorbidities. On examination, P-90/min, saturation normal, afebrile, pallor+, RR- 13/min, BP-110/76mmHg. Abdominal examination shows fundus below xiphisternum, vertical lie, cephalic presentation, head engaged, FHR-140/min, contractions-6/10mins. PV examination shows cervix soft, effaced, dilated-7cm, 1.5cm length, membranes absent, head at station +2. NST is normal. The patient had a normal vaginal delivery; the baby cried immediately after birth and weight-3kg. Her placenta is as shown in the image. The clinical significance of the presence of such placenta is: 1. Abortion 2. Antepartum hemorrhage 3. IUGR 4. Preterm delivery Select the correct answer from the given below code:
